transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess what brings me in is that I've been eating just... way too much at once. 

It mostly happens after my late shifts. I'll stop for takeout on the drive back and end up eating two burgers, fries, a shake... and then the thing is, I'll still go home and clean out the leftovers in the garage fridge. It's like I'm having a whole second supper right after the first one. It's just getting out of hand, and I figured I needed to talk to somebody about it.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever feel the need to do something to get rid of the food or compensate for the calories, such as vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

No, I don't do anything like that. I don't make myself throw up or take laxatives or anything. And after a long shift on the floor and eating all that, I'm definitely not going out to exercise. 

I mostly just... I just sit there feeling pretty awful and stuffed, and then I eventually go to sleep. So no, I don't try to get rid of it.
During these times when you eat a large amount of food, do you feel like you are unable to stop or that you cannot control how much you are eating?

Yeah, that's exactly how it is. Once I start eating, it feels like a switch is flipped. Even while I’m sitting there telling myself, 'Roy, just shut the bag and go inside,' I just can't do it. My hands just keep reaching for more. I really don't feel like I have any control over it once I get going.
When you have these episodes, how do you feel emotionally afterwards?

Honestly, I feel pretty terrible. I feel... ashamed, really. And just kind of disgusted with myself. 

I've always thought of myself as a pretty disciplined guy, you know? Dependable. I do my job, I handle my responsibilities. But doing this... it makes me feel like I'm just sneaking around. It really just feels like I'm letting myself down.
On average, how many times a week would you say these episodes occur?

For the past few months, I'd say there's usually at least one night a week where it happens. But honestly, it's often more like two or three times a week. It really just depends on work. If I'm getting off a late shift, or if I've just had a really rough day on the line, that's usually when I end up doing it.
When you have these episodes, are you usually physically hungry, or are you eating these large amounts even when you don't feel hungry?

I'm not usually hungry, no. I mean, sometimes I might be a little hungry if I haven't had dinner yet, but mostly... mostly I'm just eating to eat. Even if I'm already full, I'll still eat the whole bag or whatever I picked up. It's not about being hungry at all.
Over what period of time have these episodes been occurring at this frequency?
I'd say it's been going on for about five months now. It started right around the time I was put in the acting lead role on the CNC line at the plant.
When you are having these episodes, would you say that you are eating much more rapidly than you normally would?

Yeah, definitely. When I'm out in my truck or in the workshop, I eat so fast... half the time I barely even taste what I'm eating. It's almost like I'm trying to get it all down before somebody catches me doing it.
